# Cohen, Placitella & Roth, P.C.

> Philadelphia-based personal injury law firm specializing in medical malpractice, birth injuries, asbestos litigation, and product liability with offices across Pennsylvania and New Jersey.

Cohen, Placitella & Roth, P.C. (CPR) is a full-service personal injury law firm serving the Philadelphia region and beyond. The firm handles complex cases involving medical negligence, catastrophic injuries, asbestos exposure, and defective medical devices, with experienced attorneys across multiple practice areas.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Personal Injury Law
- Mesothelioma & Asbestos Litigation
- Birth Injuries
- Cerebral Palsy

- Spinal Cord Injury
- Medical Device Litigation
- Product Liability

- Philadelphia & New Jersey
